text.content:
Virtues: Conscience and Self-Control (this Path's Conscience tracks personal integrity, not remorse)

Followers (Knights) believe honor - rigorous, rational enforcement of one's own commitments - is what holds vampire society together absent human morality. A Knight who has sworn an oath keeps it completely; outside any sworn commitment, a Knight is free to act in pure self-interest. The Path formalizes the ideals of the Code of Milan.

Hierarchy of Sin (most to least severe):

  1. Breaking a commitment you have made
  2. Showing fear, or letting it override duty
  3. Failing to show appropriate respect, loyalty, or consideration up and down the hierarchy
  4. Failing to repay a debt in full, or failing to support comrades-at-arms (short of treachery)

Typical followers: Ventrue and Salubri antitribu, Nosferatu and Tzimisce antitribu, lucid Malkavian antitribu, increasingly Panders; favors Fortitude, Presence, Potence.
